connector.name: Simulatte
connector.registryDescription: Run synthetic research studies from any MCP client. 25+ SKUs + cross-study insights.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the iqbalahmed7 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIMULATTE_API_KEY
env.description: Your Simulatte workspace API key (format: sim_live_…). Generate one at https://app.simulatte.io/settings/api-keys

env.name: SIMULATTE_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Simulatte API. Defaults to https://app.simulatte.io/api — only override for self-hosted or staging environments.
